| INV-SNAPSHOTS-01 | A snapshot's `as_of_date` is pinned to its `year_month` month — the `<table>_as_of_in_month` CHECK (migration 00003) fires on insert and update across all four snapshot tables; an out-of-month date is `ErrSnapshotDateOutsideMonth` (400), a NULL or in-month date passes | `backend/internal/repo/snapshot_as_of_month_test.go` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-02 | At most one live snapshot per (position, year_month) — the unique index is partial (`WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`), so a soft-deleted row is superseded by a fresh re-record of the same month as a genuinely new row, not a resurrection (#57); creating a second snapshot while the first is still live hits the same index and is mapped to the informative `ErrSnapshotMonthExists` (409), not a generic 500 (#395) | `backend/internal/repo/snapshot_as_of_month_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/repo/snapshot_month_exists_test.go` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-03 | A soft-deleted snapshot is excluded from every value read — the live list, the latest-per-position selection, and the report-feeding query all carry `deleted_at IS NULL`, so a corrected or removed reading never re-enters net worth | `backend/internal/repo/snapshot_as_of_month_test.go` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-04 | Bulk import is an upsert keyed by (position, year_month): last-write-wins overwrites an existing month in place rather than double-counting, dry-run writes nothing, and the whole batch is one transaction | `backend/internal/repo/import_snapshots_test.go` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-05 | A snapshot is a past observation — a future `year_month` (`CodeFutureYearMonth`) or future `as_of_date` (`CodeSnapshotFutureDate`) is rejected 400 on both the create and update paths. The check (shared `dateguard.IsFuture`/`IsFutureMonth`, used by all four snapshot tables **and** investment transaction dates) tolerates the maximum forward timezone offset (UTC+14 → one civil day ahead of UTC) so a UTC+ member's local "today", which can be UTC-tomorrow, is not falsely rejected (#426); only a date/month more than one civil day past UTC today is "future". Verified in `dateguard_test.go` (pure boundary) | `backend/internal/assets/snapshots_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/dateguard/dateguard_test.go`<br>`backend/internal/investments/snapshots_test.go` |
| INV-SNAPSHOTS-06 | Bulk monthly-entry save is dirty-rows-only, atomic, and month-aware — uniformly across every group: the amount-only groups (Asset/Liability/Receivable, #421→#422), the qty×price Investment group (Stock/MutualFund/Gold, #423), and the accrued Investment group (Bond/TimeDeposit, #424).
